title: Compliance Matrix: Diagnosis Codes, Medicare Screening and Frequency Limits by Service Class
content:
For Laboratory Test Orders billed to insurance, three compliance settings are fixed per service class: whether ICD-10 diagnosis codes must be on file before collection, whether Original Medicare medical-necessity and frequency screening (the Advance Beneficiary Notice screening) applies, and which tests carry a Medicare frequency limit.

| Service class | ICD-10 codes required before an insurance-billed order is collected | Original Medicare ABN screening applies | Medicare frequency limits (minimum calendar days between Medicare-covered performances of the same test for the same patient) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | Yes | Yes | 496 Hemoglobin A1c: 90 days; 7600 Lipid Panel: 365 days |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | Yes | Yes | 17306 Vitamin D, 25-Hydroxy, Total: 365 days |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | Yes | Yes | 17985 Chromogranin A: 180 days |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | Yes | Yes | 91431 Chlamydia trachomatis and Neisseria gonorrhoeae RNA, TMA: 365 days |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | Yes | Yes | none |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | Yes | No | 91384 ThinPrep Pap Test: 730 days |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | Yes | Yes | none |

## Notes

- A test not listed in the frequency column has no Medicare frequency limit.
- Every class requires diagnosis codes on file before an insurance-billed order is collected.
- Anatomic Pathology & Cytology is the only class to which ABN screening does not apply; its Pap test nevertheless carries a listed frequency of 730 days.

**Example (hypothetical).** A Routine Clinical Testing order for an Original Medicare Part B patient lists the Hemoglobin A1c; its frequency limit is 90 calendar days. The Vitamin B12 on the same order has no listed limit.
